findings.evidence: Both frames show “Your first AI service.” and “DeepSeek V4.1 Flash” around a salon reception scene, but neither identifies the service being offered or the salon owner’s benefit.
findings.suggestion: Add a short subtitle naming the intended salon service and its concrete benefit, while retaining the owner and reception desk as the focal point.

findings.evidence: The end frame adds three floating cards containing dots and pale horizontal lines. Their purpose is not identifiable, so their relationship to the owner’s work remains ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Give the cards a consistent, recognizable cue tied to the intended service, such as a shared icon and a short readable label, rather than relying on generic text-like lines.
